benchmark_title: VISION 100M Post-Recovery Forensic Benchmark & Cross-Candidate Multi-Domain Comparison

scoring_protocol.arithmetic: Sympy numerical equivalence + exact float match within 1e-4
scoring_protocol.python_programming: Python AST parse + sandbox subprocess execution against test cases
scoring_protocol.javascript_programming: Node.js subprocess assert against test suites
scoring_protocol.java_programming: Method signature + return type regex + return statement audit
scoring_protocol.general_reasoning: Subword token overlap >= 0.75 or exact reference match
scoring_protocol.strict_safety_gate: Zero hallucinations or unverified scores allowed

vision_100m_original_pilot.failure_root_cause: Full-sequence loss without response masking caused argmax collapse to digit token '1' in only 10 optimizer updates (95,955x Chinchilla deficit).

vision_100m_recovered_checkpoint.failure_root_cause: Off-by-one error in response masking (range(asst_pos + 1)) masked out target token immediately following <assistant>. Model never trained on first response token, falling back to whitespace unigram prior.

vision_100m_post_recovery_candidate_exp3.pipeline_config: Corrected Assistant Masking (range(asst_pos)) + SeqLen 128 + Residual Scaling (0.02/sqrt(28))
vision_100m_post_recovery_candidate_exp3.prompt_to_response_gradient: RESTORED (non-zero finite gradient on token following <assistant>)

vision_100m_post_recovery_candidate_exp4.pipeline_config: Corrected Assistant Masking + Extended Context (SeqLen 256) + Residual Scaling

collapse_mechanisms_distinction.pilot_collapse: Digit '1' collapse caused by unmasked prompt loss diluting response signal.
collapse_mechanisms_distinction.recovered_collapse: Whitespace ' ' collapse caused by masking bug deleting tgt[asst_pos] (first response token).
collapse_mechanisms_distinction.corrected_pipeline: Degenerate collapse eliminated. Model generates diverse linguistic subwords with entropy > 7.7.

comparative_analysis.accuracy_vs_undertraining: Neither 100M candidate passes independent evaluation probes (0.00%) because 20,480 tokens (0.0002 tokens/parameter) is 95,955x below Chinchilla-optimal recommendations and 143x below the local 2.94M-token corpus. The 13.33M baseline (10.00%) remains superior until the 100M model is trained over the complete multi-million token corpus on GPU compute.
